title: The commit-msg hook refuses a planning commit whose KB-Work names an item it does not change, as check-trailers does at the push
goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, and the commit is not made, for a backlog-planning commit whose KB-Work names an item whose file it does not change, since check-trailers refuses that commit at the push anyway (SP-7nv2ffr2: the hook printed the refusal and the commit was made, then amended by hand) (SP-7nv2ffr2 close).
